text:
katie: CI red on PR #824 - mkdocs failing on quickstart.md frontmatter and a couple of images 404ing after redirect. anyone touching examples?

docs-ci-bot: build failed: mkdocs build exit code 1
log: \"while scanning a simple key\" at docs/tutorials/quickstart.md:3

naveen: link? branch? I'll look.

katie: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/824 — I moved examples under static/assets and updated mdx snippets.

eli: saw similar yesterday. our CDN strips trailing spaces in redirects, so links with accidental spaces end up 404. also stray tabs in YAML frontmatter break mkdocs.

sanjay: i'll run mkdocs locally to reproduce.

katie: top of quickstart.md from the PR:
```
---
title: Quickstart
permalink: /quickstart/
  tags: [quickstart]  # misindented (yaml parse error)
---
```

naveen: that extra two-space indent on tags is it. easy fix.

eli: and found an image link with trailing space: `![arch](../static/assets/arch.png )` — removes during redirect resolve.

sanjay: quick grep: `rg "\)\s$" -n docs | sed -n '1,40p'` to find trailing-space image links. i'll patch occurrences.

naveen: pushing a tiny fix to the PR branch: commit "docs(quickstart): fix frontmatter indent; strip trailing spaces from img links"

docs-ci-bot: CI: rebuild for PR #824 (branch: fix/quickstart-frontmatter)

docs-ci-bot: build succeeded, preview deployed -> https://deploy-preview-824.docs.redwood.com/tutorials/quickstart

eli: preview renders fine; no mkdocs warnings and images load.

katie: can we add a pre-commit or GH action step to catch these before CI? yamllint and a small asset-check would help.

naveen: i'll add a yamllint job in docs GH actions and a markdown-image-check step. will follow up with a PR.

sanjay: opening an issue to add a lightweight smoke test that renders docs and checks image URLs return 200 (follow redirects).

katie: thanks — aim is to avoid late CI surprises. merging once yamllint is live on main.
